Make the gift feel like them

Choose who stars in it
Use a clear photo you have permission to share. The character is drawn from the photo. Choose the reading level separately, from age three through to adult.
Give the story a starting point
Pick a story idea or write your own. A favourite animal, a football obsession or a family in-joke can give the adventure somewhere to begin.
Leave a note inside
Add who the book is from and a short dedication. Try “For your seventh birthday, from Gran. May you always ask what’s round the next corner.”

Price and birthday delivery

What will the book cost?
A5 is £24.99, or £28.98 with UK postage. A4 is £29.99, or £33.98 with UK postage. Both have a matte hardback cover and 24 full-colour inside pages.
What can I see before I buy?
The free preview shows their illustrated character and opening pages. You can change the words before deciding whether to order.
When should I order?
Allow up to seven calendar days after payment for the full illustrated proof. Once you approve it, printing and UK delivery usually take another 7 to 12 working days. Leave extra time for changes before their birthday. Read the delivery details.

Who’s celebrating?

Start with their name and see how they look on the page. You can make the preview without a payment card.
